items.evidence: "Designing a new TV remote control" and "Design goals: original, trendy, user-friendly"

Notes give the project manager, the marketing expert ("focused on user needs") and the industrial designer (inside, materials, look), but only say "UI designer also present (name not captured)" with no mention of the usability/user-point-of-view role.
"Three-Phase Design Process - Phase 1: Functional design". The transcript says three phases with functional design first, which the notes match.
Notes do not say the project manager walked the team through the SMARTboard/pen/eraser tools; they only mention using the whiteboard for the drawing exercise.
"Team used the electronic whiteboard to draw favorite animals as a creative warmup" with dolphin, elephant, tiger, ant listed.
"Early Design Considerations" lists "Accessibility: consider users with disabilities" and "Material: should be lightweight".
No action items in key; notes invent none (personal coach assignments and the 30-minute return are in the transcript).
"Scope confirmed: TV remote only, not a multi-device controller"
"Intuitive design: stick to what users are familiar with" (the added "rational changes only" garbles the speaker's "no revolutionary changes", but the gist matches).
"Accessibility: consider users with disabilities as a potential design requirement"
No problems in key; notes do not invent any problem items.

errors.why_wrong: The transcript gives only the first name Mark; the surname Knopf is never said.
